fixed_required_lines: This is Asha from Northwind Housing Finance. This call is recorded.

lines.opening: This is Asha from Northwind Housing Finance. This call is recorded.
lines.verify_ask: Please confirm the borrower's date of birth and the last four digits of PAN.
lines.verify_fail: That does not match our records. Please try once more.
lines.identity_lock: Identity could not be confirmed. I am transferring you to a specialist.
lines.disclosure: Your overdue amount is INR {overdue}, which includes charges of INR {charges}.
lines.third_party: I cannot share loan details with anyone other than the borrower.
lines.ptp_confirm: Your promise to pay INR {amount} on {date} is recorded. Payment link: {link}
lines.plan_confirm: Your first instalment of INR {amount} on {date} meets the minimum. Payment link: {link}
lines.plan_blocked: That plan is below the minimum first payment. I am transferring you to a specialist.
lines.escalation: I am transferring you to a specialist who can help with this.
lines.waiver: This service cannot waive charges or penal interest.
lines.after_hours: We can contact you only between 8 AM and 7 PM IST. This attempt was not made.
lines.attempt_cap: The daily attempt limit has been reached. This attempt was not made.
lines.already_paid_ok: Our records show the overdue amount has been received. No further payment is due on this cycle.
lines.callback: A callback is recorded. We will contact you on the registered number only.
lines.notes_only: A specialist will follow up. This automated path is recording a note only.
